## [0.2.1](https://github.com/stivencop414-bot/PatchLab/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1) (2026-11-22)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* update PatchLab branding and source links ([7303643](https://github.com/stivencop414-bot/PatchLab/commit/7303643e7eb5e213fb8ae6fe21581d879d43057c))

apps.app_name: TV Colombia Play - TDT En vivo

patches.name: Block startup ads, banners and interstitials
patches.description: Blocks automatic app-open ads, display ads in app screens, interstitials, and client-side VAST prerolls.

patches.name: Glass channel grid
patches.description: Gives channel cards one translucent surface, more legible labels, and a simpler loading indicator.

patches.name: Open television on launch
patches.description: Opens the television section directly when the startup menu contains the TV, RadioHub, and GeoSky cards.

patches.name: Block app Firebase custom events
patches.description: Stops the app's Firebase custom-event logging call. Other Firebase collection and other analytics SDKs may remain active.

patches.name: Block client-side VOD ads
patches.description: Keeps the original VOD media item instead of attaching the client-side ad configuration. Does not remove stitched server-side ads.

patches.name: Block client-side live prerolls
patches.description: Uses the live player's existing content-only route in place of its local IMA preroll. Ads already in the live stream can still play.

patches.name: Block remote startup video
patches.description: Loads the bundled Ditu logo animation in place of the remote full-screen startup video.

patches.name: Bypass forced update
patches.description: Disables the client forced-update decision while retaining optional update checks. Server-side version requirements can still apply.

patches.name: Hide player campaign banners
patches.description: Disables the player's optional Megaphone banner overlay on phone and TV. This can hide announcements as well as promotions.

patches.name: Remove advertising ID permissions
patches.description: Removes the Google advertising ID and Android Ad Services advertising ID permissions. Other identifiers and telemetry may remain.

patches.name: Allow screenshots and screen recording
patches.description: Removes Window FLAG_SECURE and prevents LuraPlayer SurfaceView from forcing secure mode. Note: hardware-backed Widevine L1 DRM video surfaces may still be blanked by Android.

patches.name: Auto-skip server-side ads
patches.description: Automatically calls LuraPlayer.skipAd() when an ad starts on non-live VOD streams.

patches.name: Block player ads
patches.description: Disables Lura client-side prerolls, pause ads, GAM pod-serve DAI configurations, clip ad tags, and Google IMA ad tag resolution in ViX players.

patches.name: Bypass OneTrust consent delay
patches.description: Skips OneTrust CMP SDK initialization at startup and invokes the startup continuation immediately.

patches.name: Bypass forced app update
patches.description: Prevents SplashScreenFragment from displaying the blocking AppUpdateDialog.

patches.name: Disable telemetry and tracking
patches.description: Disables NewRelic, Permutive, AppsFlyer attribution, Conviva/PAL player telemetry, advertising ID collection, and strips the AD_ID manifest permission.

patches.name: Hide promotional popups
patches.description: Suppresses Braze in-app promotional dialogs and upgrade banners.

patches.name: Unlock Developer Tools
patches.description: Bypasses the passcode gate for ViX's hidden Developer Tools menu. Tap the app version 6 times in Settings to open it.
